settings.heading: We started with *one question.*
settings.text:
Why do we spend weeks choosing our own mattress — and thirty seconds choosing theirs?

Our pets spend more time in bed than anywhere else. Dogs sleep 12–14 hours a day; cats, up to 16. Yet most pet beds are chosen on colour and price, and sized with a guess.

Snoozly exists to do it differently. We sort every bed by the way pets really sleep — curled, sprawled, leaning or burrowed — explain sizing properly, and only stock beds from makers we'd trust with our own.

settings.heading: Half their life happens *in bed.*
settings.text: It's where they recover, wait for you to come home, and dream about the park. We think that deserves more than a guess.

settings.title: Sorted by sleep, not by colour
settings.text: Every bed belongs to one of five sleep needs — Calm, Support, Cool, Cosy or Stretch — so you can shop by what your pet actually needs.

settings.title: Sized properly
settings.text: A breed-by-breed size guide beside every size button, and a 60-second Sleep Match that tells you what to look for.

settings.title: Only makers we trust
settings.text: We stock beds from established makers, and tell you plainly what each one is made of and how to care for it.

settings.title: Honest about delivery
settings.text: Every product page shows a real delivery window before you buy — including the few beds that ship from our makers' own warehouses.

settings.heading: Four promises behind *every bed.*
settings.text: These are the rules every Snoozly bed has to pass before it gets anywhere near your living room.

settings.heading: Give them the best sleep of *their whole life.*
settings.text: They'd never ask. That's exactly why it's worth getting right.
